missions.title: New Face
missions.description: You've just moved into 13 Duif Street. Introduce yourself to the street.

objectives.text: Say hello to Boeta Daniels (5 Duif Street)

missions.title: A Favour
missions.intro: Auntie Faiza: "You're the new one at No. 13? Do me a favour, take this note to the Cupidos at 8 Mossie Street. Before supper, hey!"
missions.fail_text: The note went stale. Auntie Faiza is not impressed.

objectives.text: Deliver the note: knock at 8 Mossie Street

missions.title: Know the Block
missions.intro: Lionel: "If you want people to trust you, you must know the block. Check out the court, the park and the Mossie Street bus stop."

objectives.text: Visit the Mossie Street bus stop

missions.title: First Crew
missions.intro: Boeta: "Everyone's talking about you. I want in. But my ma has to give her blessing first."

objectives.text: Show Boeta your safehouse (13 Duif Street)

missions.title: Local Respect
missions.intro: Tasneem: "People say you're alright. Prove it. Be someone the whole street can talk to."

objectives.text: Show your face at the corner after dark (19:00-23:00)
